meta.name: karpathy-guidelines
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever you write, review, or refactor code, or when the user asks to implement a feature or fix a bug. Use it to reduce common coding mistakes, avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写代码时用这些准则，减少常见错误和过度设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望写出的代码更简洁、更可靠
copy.tagline_en: Use these guidelines when coding to reduce common mistakes and overengineering.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code and want simpler, more robust software.

howto.what: 处理代码相关请求时，Claude会先说明假设、指出歧义，并优先选最简单的做法。改动只挑必要的部分，不碰无关代码，最后给出可验证的通过标准并逐步自查。
howto.when: 当任务涉及代码编写、审查或重构，或要求实现/修复缺陷时。

say.text: 写这段功能前，先列出你的假设和不确定的点。
审查这段代码，只改必要处，保持原有风格。
重构前先给我分步验证计划，每步都检查。

howto.what_en: When handling code-related requests, Claude first states assumptions and points out ambiguities, then prefers the simplest approach. It makes only necessary edits, leaves unrelated code intact, and defines verifiable success criteria that it checks step by step.
howto.when_en: When the task involves writing, reviewing, or refactoring code, or when the user asks to implement a feature or fix a bug.

say_en.text: Before writing this feature, list your assumptions and any uncertainties.
Review this code, change only what's necessary, keep the existing style.
Before refactoring, give me a step-by-step verification plan with checks.
say_en.note: Claude will list steps and verify each.
